answer: The beacon schedule is applied in lagoon and willow publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4920 identities would post 1436 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
